title: it's not magnetic....it's a clip
text: it's not magnetic....it's a clip. Well I'm disappointed that it isn't magnetic...there is a big clip on the back which I have no idea where you're supposed to mount it...the idea of the recording is awesome...my nephews live across the country and I don't want them to forget me so I thought a picture with my voice would be good...just wish it could go on the fridge
